title: JensonTheTurtle's swords.
description: My first resource pack. :D Its all about swords to make them either shinier or just the way it is. Also, I kinda forgot copper. V2?
body: This is my first resource pack. It's nothing fancy, just a new look if you don't like the old ones. There may be some that are better and cooler, but this pack is more for me because I like it nice and simple. All the swords(except for copper) are made. I hope it's good and it's nice and cool for me. I hope you feel the same and hope you download it.
